Tieks Ballet Flats, Electric Snake
Channel your inner wild side in enchanting Electric Snake Tieks. With a blend of metallic gold, pink, aqua and black, these lust-worthy ballet flats will capture the spotlight. Made with premium, soft, top-grain Italian leather. Non-elasticized, cushioned back and padded instep. Foldable split-sole design for ultimate portability. Signature Tiek Blue stripes and durable, non-skid rubber soles.
